pages.privacy_intro: How we collect, use, and store your data

0.heading: What data we collect
0.body: When you contact us via the form or messenger buttons, we collect what you enter yourself: your name, the contact channel you picked and the contact itself - a phone number, a Telegram handle or a link to your Facebook profile - and the direction you're interested in.

1.heading: Why we collect it
1.body: We use this data only to connect you with a MELBET partnership manager and confirm the terms of cooperation. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for marketing.

2.heading: How long we keep it
2.body: Submitted lead data is stored for up to 90 days, after which it is automatically deleted from our systems.

3.heading: Analytics and cookies
3.body: To see where visitors come from and which parts of the page actually help them, we use Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity, Cloudflare Web Analytics and the BeMob click tracker. The recipients of this data are Google LLC, Microsoft Corporation and Cloudflare, Inc. What we collect is anonymous statistics: pages viewed and actions taken on the site, the referral source, device type and language. Your name, phone number and messenger handle never reach analytics: they travel through the form only, and only to a manager. The referral tag is kept in your own browser (localStorage) for up to 90 days - the same period we keep a request. You can opt out through your own browser: private browsing, a content blocker, or by disallowing site data. Visitors from the European Economic Area, the UK and Switzerland are not counted at all by default: there, collection starts only with their own decision. If you made such a decision, you can change it with the button below, in this same section.

4.heading: Your rights & contact
4.body: You can ask us to review, correct, or delete your data at any time by contacting your manager or writing to us via Telegram.
